summary: Verified Safe-delete / Undo-delete (P1) end-to-end. Backend: full pytest passes 116/116 in ~25s including the 8 new soft-delete/restore/purge tests. Live-URL curl smoke validated exact response contracts: DELETE returns {ok,soft_deleted:true,project_id,deleted_at,delete_expires_at,previous_status}; GET 404 for soft-deleted (200 with ?include_deleted=true); list excludes soft-deleted; second DELETE is idempotent with already_deleted:true; POST /restore re-activates and clears flags; restore on unknown -> 404; delete on unknown -> {ok:true,soft_deleted:false,exists:false}; POST /admin/purge-deleted-projects returns purge counts and leaves non-expired soft-deleted + active untouched (0 purged when none expired). Frontend: trash button on hover triggers optimistic single-click delete (no confirm dialog), 'Deleted "X"' toast appears with Undo action; Undo restores within 5s with 'Restored "X"' toast and card reappears; letting 5s elapse + page refresh confirms the project remains hidden. Dashboard stats (Projects, In progress) recompute correctly on each transition: 3/2 -> 4/3 (create) -> 3/2 (delete) -> 4/3 (undo) -> 3/2 (delete+expire+refresh). Strict mock-mode banner still visible. Zero console errors during the flow.

endpoint_verification.POST /api/projects/{id}/restore: 200 -> deleted_at:null, status restored to 'draft'. List re-includes. PASS

frontend_verification.Trash button (hover): data-testid=delete-project-btn-<id> hidden by opacity-0, revealed on group-hover, no AlertDialog opened on click. PASS

critical_code_review_comments: _active_project_filter cleanly handles both missing and null deleted_at via $or — good defensive shape for the migration from hard-delete docs without that field.
delete_project's idempotency response includes already_deleted:true exactly as the spec requires; previous_status preserved across re-deletes (not overwritten).
restore_project unsets deleted_at, deleted_by, delete_expires_at, previous_status atomically and restores status from previous_status (default 'draft'). Correct.

admin_purge_deleted_projects cascades to scenes/characters/segments/provider_activity by project_id list — but provider_activity rows without a project_id (e.g. health checks) are correctly NOT swept. Good scoping.
update_project uses _active_project_filter so a PUT on a soft-deleted project correctly returns 404 — protects against accidental zombie writes. Good.

Carry-over from iter 4 (now resolved by design): segments cascade is now handled by purge path, since soft-delete intentionally keeps children intact for restore. The old 'no segment cascade' comment is no longer a bug.
Minor: the SOFT_DELETE_TTL_HOURS=24 constant lives at module scope — consider moving to env for ops tunability, but not required for MVP.

Frontend Dashboard.jsx onDelete uses sonner's toast() with action.label='Undo' and duration:5000 — matches spec; the action callback re-fetches Projects.list() so cost_summary stays fresh on restored card.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up ephemeral TEST_softdel_* and TEST_undo_flow_ABC projects via API and UI. One TEST_undo_flow_ABC project was left soft-deleted in the preview env (its delete_expires_at is +24h, will be auto-purged by /admin/purge-deleted-projects after that). 3 seeded projects (ScoreCheck, TEST UI Project, Test Ep) remain active and untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest baseline is now 116 tests (`cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` ~25s). Soft-delete contract: DELETE returns {ok, soft_deleted, project_id, deleted_at, delete_expires_at, previous_status} or {ok:true, soft_deleted:false, exists:false} on unknown, or {…, already_deleted:true} on re-delete. GET 404 for soft-deleted unless ?include_deleted=true. POST /api/projects/{id}/restore brings it back (404 if id doesn't exist anywhere). POST /api/admin/purge-deleted-projects purges only rows whose delete_expires_at <= now. Frontend Dashboard now uses sonner toast.action.label='Undo' on a 5s timer — testids: delete-project-btn-<id>, project-delete-toast, project-restore-toast. Trash btn is hover-revealed (opacity-0 -> 100); use force=True on click and hover the card first. Strict mock mode still enforced; provider invariant from iter 4 still holds.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. Feature works exactly per spec: soft-delete + 24h purge window + 5s optimistic undo with fresh re-fetch on restore, and stats recomputation is purely client-side from the projects array so it follows transitions correctly.
